title: E78 research evidence ledger
description: Public-safe authored summaries refer to private source documents. Paths are provenance labels relative to the originating collection, not public download locations. Source hashes identify document versions; unpublished evidence cannot be independently verified from this ledger alone. Historical source statements are superseded where later records are explicitly cited.

analyzed_image.transferability: OS number alone insufficient; addresses and active configuration require exact-image validation.
